"""Build the static demo: ONE self-contained HTML file with the knowledge base inside.

    python scripts/build_demo.py            # -> dist/index.html (+ dist/kb.json)
    python scripts/build_demo.py --embedded # no live refresh from GitHub (for sandboxed hosts)

The demo needs no server. Search runs in the browser (web/engine.js); answers
come from Claude when the page is opened inside Claude, otherwise the page shows
the best matching excerpts. GitHub Pages serves this file (see .github/workflows).
"""
import base64
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
WEB = ROOT / "web"
DIST = ROOT / "dist"


def main() -> None:
    html = (WEB / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    kb = (ROOT / "data" / "kb.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    json.loads(kb)  # fail early on a broken file

    def inline_css(m):
        return "<style>\n" + (WEB / m.group(1)).read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\n</style>"

    def inline_js(m):
        return "<script>\n" + (WEB / m.group(1)).read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("</script", "<\\/script") + "\n</script>"

    html = re.sub(r'<link rel="stylesheet" href="([\w.]+)">', inline_css, html)
    html = re.sub(r'<script src="([\w.]+)"></script>', inline_js, html)
    icon = base64.b64encode((WEB / "icon.svg").read_bytes()).decode()
    html = html.replace('href="icon.svg"', f'href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,{icon}"')
    embedded = "--embedded" in sys.argv
    if embedded:  # sandboxed host (an artifact): no manifest, no service worker, no live refresh
        html = re.sub(r'\s*<link rel="manifest"[^>]*>|\s*<link rel="apple-touch-icon"[^>]*>', "", html)
        html = re.sub(r"kbUrl: '[^']*'", "kbUrl: ''", html)
        html = html.replace("window.YAKOV_CONFIG = {", "window.YAKOV_EMBEDDED = true;\n    window.YAKOV_CONFIG = {", 1)
    kb_script = "<script>window.YAKOV_KB = " + kb.replace("</", "<\\/") + ";</script>\n"
    html = html.replace("</head>", kb_script + "</head>", 1)

    DIST.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (DIST / "index.html").write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
    (DIST / "kb.json").write_text(kb, encoding="utf-8")
    if not embedded:  # installable app (PWA) files
        for name in ("manifest.webmanifest", "sw.js", "icon.svg", "icon-192.png", "icon-512.png",
                     "icon-maskable-512.png", "apple-touch-icon.png"):
            (DIST / name).write_bytes((WEB / name).read_bytes())
    print(f"dist/index.html · {len(html.encode()) / 1e6:.1f} MB")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Split source files into chunks that keep their file path and line numbers.

Every chunk remembers where it came from (repo, path, first and last line), so
an answer can cite "bomberman/ai.py lines 24-58" and link straight to GitHub.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import html
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

CODE_WINDOW = 60      # lines per code chunk
CODE_OVERLAP = 8      # lines repeated between neighbouring code chunks
MD_TARGET = 1500      # characters per markdown chunk (soft)
MD_MAX = 2400         # a section longer than this is split by paragraphs
HTML_WINDOW = 40

DEF_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:async\s+)?"
    r"(?:def|class|function|const|let|interface|type|enum)\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"
)
HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)")


@dataclass
class Chunk:
    id: str
    repo: str
    path: str
    start: int          # 1-based first line
    end: int            # 1-based last line
    title: str          # heading path for docs, first definition for code
    kind: str           # "doc" | "code" | "page" | "config"
    text: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


def _kind_for(path: str) -> str:
    low = path.lower()
    if low.endswith((".md", ".txt", ".rst")):
        return "doc"
    if low.endswith((".html", ".htm")):
        return "page"
    if low.endswith((".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".json", ".ini", ".cfg", ".bat", ".sh")) or low.endswith("dockerfile") or "/dockerfile" in low:
        return "config"
    return "code"


def _strip_html(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Visible text of an HTML page, one output line per input line."""
    joined = "\n".join(lines)
    # Drop script/style bodies but keep their newlines so line numbers stay true.
    joined = re.sub(r"(?is)<(script|style)\b.*?</\1>", lambda m: "\n" * m.group(0).count("\n"), joined)
    joined = re.sub(r"(?s)<!--.*?-->", lambda m: "\n" * m.group(0).count("\n"), joined)
    joined = re.sub(r"<[^>\n]*>", " ", joined)
    joined = html.unescape(joined)
    return [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", ln).strip() for ln in joined.split("\n")]

def _chunk_markdown(repo: str, path: str, lines: list[str]) -> list[Chunk]:
    sections: list[tuple[str, int, list[str]]] = []  # (heading path, start line, lines)
    stack: list[str] = []
    cur: list[str] = []
    cur_start = 1
    in_fence = False
    for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if line.strip().startswith("```"):
            in_fence = not in_fence
        m = None if in_fence else HEADING_RE.match(line)
        if m:
            if any(s.strip() for s in cur):
                sections.append((" › ".join(stack), cur_start, cur))
            level = len(m.group(1))
            stack = stack[: level - 1] + [m.group(2).strip().strip("*")]
            cur, cur_start = [line], i
        else:
            cur.append(line)
    if any(s.strip() for s in cur):
        sections.append((" › ".join(stack), cur_start, cur))

    # Merge small neighbouring sections; split very long ones by paragraph.
    chunks: list[Chunk] = []
    buf: list[str] = []
    buf_start, buf_title = 1, ""

    def flush(end_line: int) -> None:
        nonlocal buf
        text = "\n".join(buf).strip()
        if text:
            chunks.append(Chunk("", repo, path, buf_start, end_line, buf_title or path, "doc", text))
        buf = []

    for title, start, sec in sections:
        sec_text = "\n".join(sec)
        if len(sec_text) > MD_MAX:
            if buf:
                flush(start - 1)
            # paragraph split, still tracking line numbers
            para: list[str] = []
            p_start = start
            for j, ln in enumerate(sec):
                para.append(ln)
                size = sum(len(x) + 1 for x in para)
                if (not ln.strip() and size >= MD_TARGET) or size >= MD_MAX:
                    buf, buf_start, buf_title = para, p_start, title
                    flush(start + j)
                    para, p_start = [], start + j + 1
            if para:
                buf, buf_start, buf_title = para, p_start, title
                flush(start + len(sec) - 1)

BIDI_RE = re.compile("[\u200e\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069\ufeff]")


def chunk_file(repo: str, path: str, content: str) -> list[Chunk]:
    content = BIDI_RE.sub("", content)
    lines = content.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
    kind = _kind_for(path)
    if kind == "doc" and path.lower().endswith(".md"):
        chunks = _chunk_markdown(repo, path, lines)
    elif kind == "page":
        chunks = _chunk_lines(repo, path, lines, kind, _strip_html(lines), HTML_WINDOW)
    else:
        chunks = _chunk_lines(repo, path, lines, kind, lines, CODE_WINDOW)
    for i, c in enumerate(chunks):
        c.id = f"{repo}:{path}:{c.start}-{c.end}"
    return chunks

"""Build the knowledge base (data/kb.json) from GitHub repositories.

    python -m yakovllm.ingest --github yakov-ashgar27          # every public repo of a user (only what changed)
    python -m yakovllm.ingest --github yakov-ashgar27 --force  # rebuild everything
    python -m yakovllm.ingest --repo yakov-ashgar27/Bomberman  # one or more repos
    python -m yakovllm.ingest --local ~/code/bomberman ~/code/the-map-lies

Repos are shallow-cloned into .cache/repos. Only text files that help answer
questions are read: source code, Markdown, HTML pages and config. Lock files,
build output, binaries and anything over 200 KB are skipped.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fnmatch
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from . import tokenizer
from .chunker import chunk_file

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

DEFAULT_OUT = ROOT / "data" / "kb.json"

TEXT_EXT = {
    ".py", ".pyw", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".mjs", ".jsx", ".md", ".html", ".htm",
    ".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg", ".bat", ".sh", ".sql", ".txt", ".json",
    # other languages, so a future project in any of them is read too
    ".java", ".kt", ".c", ".h", ".cpp", ".hpp", ".cs", ".go", ".rs", ".swift", ".php", ".rb",
    ".vue", ".svelte", ".scss", ".ps1", ".r", ".ipynb",
}
SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "dist", "build", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", ".cache", "coverage", ".next"}
SKIP_FILES = {"package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "poetry.lock"}
JSON_KEEP = {"package.json", "manifest.webmanifest", "tsconfig.json"}
MAX_BYTES = 200_000
KB_VERSION = 2          # bump when chunks or metadata change shape: forces a full re-index
IGNORE_FILE = ".yakovllm-ignore"  # optional, in a repo's root: glob patterns of files to skip
CODE_EXT = {".py", ".pyw", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".mjs", ".jsx", ".html", ".htm", ".css", ".sql", ".sh", ".bat",
            ".java", ".kt", ".c", ".h", ".cpp", ".hpp", ".cs", ".go", ".rs", ".swift", ".php", ".rb",
            ".vue", ".svelte", ".scss", ".ps1", ".r"}


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)


def git(*args: str, cwd: Path | None = None) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()

def repo_info(path: Path, fallback_name: str) -> dict:
    try:

        m = re.search(r"github\.com[/:]([^/]+)/([^/]+?)(?:\.git)?$", remote)
        owner, name = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else ("", fallback_name)

        commit = git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD", cwd=path)
        committed = git("log", "-1", "--format=%cI", cwd=path)
    except Exception:
        owner, name, branch, commit, committed = "", fallback_name, "main", "", ""
    return {"owner": owner, "name": name, "branch": branch, "commit": commit, "committed_at": committed,
            "url": f"https://github.com/{owner}/{name}" if owner else ""}


def describe(name: str, owner: str, files: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(title, one-paragraph summary) from the repo's README."""
    readme = next((files[k] for k in files if k.lower() == "readme.md"), "")
    if name.lower() == owner.lower():
        title = "Profile README"
    elif name.lower().endswith(".github.io"):
        title = "Portfolio website"
    else:
        h1 = re.search(r"^#\s+(.+)$", readme, re.M)
        title = h1.group(1).strip() if h1 else name
    summary = ""
    for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", readme):
        b = block.strip()
        if b and not b.startswith(("#", "!", "|", "<", "```", "-", "*", ">")) and len(b) > 60:
            summary = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[*_`]", "", b))[:400]
            break
    if not summary and name.lower().endswith(".github.io"):
        summary = "The personal portfolio site with a page per project."
    return title, summary

def build(paths: list[tuple[Path, str]], out: Path, owner: str = "") -> dict:
    repos, chunks = [], []
    for path, name in paths:
        meta, cs = ingest_repo(path, name)
        repos.append(meta)
        chunks.extend(cs)
    return write_kb(repos, chunks, out, owner)


def write_kb(repos: list[dict], chunks: list[dict], out: Path, owner: str = "") -> dict:
    kb = {
        "version": KB_VERSION,
        "owner": owner or next((r["owner"] for r in repos if r.get("owner")), ""),
        "built_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "repos": repos,
        "tokenizer": {  # shared with web/engine.js
            "stopwords": sorted(tokenizer.STOPWORDS),
            "glossary": tokenizer.GLOSSARY,
            "aliases": tokenizer.REPO_ALIASES,
            "prefix1": "".join(sorted(tokenizer.HE_PREFIX_1)),
            "prefix2": sorted(tokenizer.HE_PREFIX_2),
        },
        "chunks": chunks,
    }
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(kb, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")), encoding="utf-8")
    log(f"wrote {out} · {len(repos)} repos · {len(chunks)} chunks · {out.stat().st_size / 1e6:.1f} MB")
    return kb

def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build the yakov.LLM knowledge base")
    ap.add_argument("--github", metavar="USER", help="ingest every public repo of this GitHub user")
    ap.add_argument("--repo", nargs="*", default=[], metavar="OWNER/NAME", help="specific GitHub repos")
    ap.add_argument("--local", nargs="*", default=[], metavar="DIR", help="local folders (git checkouts)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(DEFAULT_OUT))
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="with --github: re-index every repo, not only changed ones")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if a.github and not a.repo and not a.local:
        from .sync import GitHubSync  # full, incremental GitHub sync
        result = GitHubSync(a.github, Path(a.out)).check(force=a.force)
        print(json.dumps(result))
        if "error" in result:
            sys.exit(1)
        return
    targets: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    for full in a.repo:
        targets.append((clone(full), full.split("/")[-1]))
    for d in a.local:
        p = Path(d).expanduser().resolve()
        targets.append((p, p.name))
    if not targets:
        ap.error("give --github USER, --repo OWNER/NAME or --local DIR")
    build(targets, Path(a.out), owner=a.github or "")

"""BM25 search over the knowledge base, written from scratch (no libraries).

BM25 scores a chunk higher when it contains the query's rare words many times,
and normalises for chunk length. On top of plain BM25 we add three things that
matter for a code + docs corpus:

* field weighting: words in the repo name, file path and section title count
  as if they appeared META_WEIGHT times;
* repo focus: when the question names a project ("in Bomberman ..."), chunks
  from that project get a boost (or a hard filter when the UI picks a project);
* diversity: at most MAX_PER_FILE chunks from one file in the results, so the
  answer can draw on several places.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from . import tokenizer

K1 = 1.2
B = 0.75
META_WEIGHT = 3
REPO_BOOST = 1.6
README_BOOST = 1.15
TEST_PENALTY = 0.8    # test files echo the code's words; prefer the code unless tests are asked about
TEST_WORDS = {"test", "tests", "pytest", "vitest", "בדיקה", "בדיקות", "e2e", "playwright"}
MAX_PER_FILE = 2


@dataclass
class Hit:
    chunk: dict
    score: float
    terms: list[str]

    def to_dict(self, n: int | None = None) -> dict:
        c = self.chunk
        d = {k: c[k] for k in ("id", "repo", "path", "start", "end", "title", "kind", "text")}
        d["score"] = round(self.score, 3)
        d["terms"] = self.terms
        if n is not None:
            d["n"] = n
        return d


def is_test_path(path: str) -> bool:
    p = path.lower()
    name = p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    return p.startswith(("tests/", "test/", "e2e/")) or "/tests/" in p or "/e2e/" in p \
        or name.startswith("test_") or ".test." in name or ".spec." in name

"""yakov.LLM web server: the chat UI, a JSON API and live GitHub sync.

    python -m yakovllm.server            # http://localhost:8000

Standard library only (ThreadingHTTPServer), so it runs anywhere Python 3.10+
runs, with no install step. Answers stream to the browser as Server-Sent Events.

Environment:
    GROQ_API_KEY        free written answers (open models on Groq), or
    GEMINI_API_KEY      free written answers (Gemini Flash), or
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   Claude answers (paid). Without any key: offline excerpt mode.
    LLM_MODEL           answer model (defaults per provider, see llm.PROVIDERS)
    GITHUB_USER         account to follow       (default: the owner in kb.json)
    GITHUB_TOKEN        optional, raises the GitHub API rate limit
    SYNC_INTERVAL_MIN   minutes between GitHub checks (default 30, 0 = off)
    WEBHOOK_SECRET      secret of the GitHub webhook that triggers an instant sync
    SYNC_TOKEN          if set, POST /api/sync needs "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
    RATE_LIMIT          chat requests per IP per 10 minutes (default 30)
    CORS_ORIGINS        sites whose pages may call this API, comma-separated
                        (default https://yakov-ashgar27.github.io, the static demo)
    HOST / PORT         default 0.0.0.0:8000
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import mimetypes
import os
import queue

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "yakov.LLM"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # quieter logs: method, path, status
        if os.environ.get("QUIET"):
            return
        super().log_message(fmt, *args)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- utils
    def _cors(self):
        """Let the GitHub Pages demo call this API from the browser."""
        origin = (self.headers.get("Origin") or "").rstrip("/")
        if origin and (origin in CORS_ORIGINS or "*" in CORS_ORIGINS):
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin)
            self.send_header("Vary", "Origin")

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(204)
        self._cors()
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Max-Age", "86400")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def _json(self, obj, status=200):
        body = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self._cors()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _body(self, limit=200_000) -> bytes:
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if n > limit:
            raise ValueError("request too large")
        return self.rfile.read(n) if n else b""

    def _client_ip(self) -> str:
        fwd = self.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For", "")
        return fwd.split(",")[0].strip() or self.client_address[0]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Starts DocMind in the background inside a GitHub Codespace (port 8000, private to your GitHub account).
mkdir -p ${DOCMIND_DATA_DIR:-/workspaces/docmind-data}
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../backend" || exit 1
if ! curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/meta; then
  setsid nohup python run.py > ${DOCMIND_DATA_DIR:-/workspaces/docmind-data}/server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
fi

name: Android app
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["android/**", "mobile/**", ".github/workflows/android.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: android
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: "17" }
      - name: Android SDK (preinstalled on GitHub runners)
        id: sdk
        run: |
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
          ls "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms" "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/build.log
          echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME" > android/local.properties
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with: { gradle-version: "8.10.2" }
      - name: Bundle Hebrew+English OCR engine (offline OCR inside the app)
        id: ocr
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          exec > >(tee -a /tmp/build.log) 2>&1
          echo "== OCR bundle"; set -x
          T="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/mobile/vendor/tesseract"; mkdir -p "$T/core" "$T/lang" /tmp/ocr && cd /tmp/ocr
          npm pack tesseract.js@5.1.1 tesseract.js-core@5.1.1
          mkdir -p js core && tar xzf tesseract.js-5.1.1.tgz -C js && tar xzf tesseract.js-core-5.1.1.tgz -C core
          cp js/package/dist/tesseract.min.js js/package/dist/worker.min.js "$T/"
          cp core/package/tesseract-core*.js core/package/tesseract-core*.wasm "$T/core/" || true
          for l in heb eng; do
            ok=""
            for u in "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tesseract.js-data/$l/4.0.0_best_int/$l.traineddata.gz" \
                     "https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_best/$l.traineddata.gz" \
                     "https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/$l.traineddata.gz"; do
              if curl -fsSL -o "$T/lang/$l.traineddata.gz" "$u"; then ok=1; echo "got $l from $u"; break; fi
            done
            [ -n "$ok" ] || { echo "could not download $l"; exit 1; }
          done
          # tesseract.js 5 with LSTM (oem 1) only ever loads these two cores (SIMD and non-SIMD phones).
          # The other six variants are ~22 MB of dead weight in the APK, so they are not shipped.
          find "$T/core" -type f ! -name 'tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js' ! -name 'tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js' -delete
          ls -la "$T" "$T/core" "$T/lang"
      - name: Drop partial OCR bundle (app then downloads OCR once instead)
        if: steps.ocr.outcome != 'success'
        run: rm -rf mobile/vendor/tesseract && echo "OCR bundle skipped" | tee -a /tmp/build.log
      - name: Signing key
        env:
          KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.DOCMIND_KEYSTORE_B64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_B64" ]; then echo "$KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/release.keystore; echo "DOCMIND_KEYSTORE=/tmp/release.keystore" >> $GITHUB_ENV; fi
      - name: Build APK
        id: build

[![Open in GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/codespaces/badge.svg)](https://codespaces.new/yakov-ashgar27/DocMind)

🌐 **Website:** https://yakov-ashgar27.github.io/DocMind/ · 🤖 **Android app (APK):** https://yakov-ashgar27.github.io/DocMind/DocMind.apk (mirror: [GitHub release](https://github.com/yakov-ashgar27/DocMind/releases/download/android-latest/DocMind.apk)) · 📱 **Web app (iPhone/any phone):** https://yakov-ashgar27.github.io/DocMind/app/

chunks.title: DocMind — Intelligent Personal Document Assistant › Two editions
chunks.text:
## Two editions

| | 📱 **Phone edition** (`mobile/`, Android app in `android/`) | 💻 **DocMind Server** (`backend/` + `frontend/`) |
|---|---|---|
| Install | Android: download the APK (built free by GitHub Actions). iPhone/any phone: open the link, then "Add to Home Screen" | Your computer, Docker or Codespaces |
| Automatic phone scan (gallery, Downloads, WhatsApp folder), Share → DocMind | Android app ✅ | — |
| Where documents live | Encrypted on the phone only (IndexedDB + WebCrypto) | Encrypted on your computer |
| Hebrew OCR, assistant, memory, bundles, vault, reminders, WhatsApp import | ✅ | ✅ |
| Gmail and Google Drive | — | ✅ |
| Server needed | No | Yes (yours) |

Both editions share one knowledge base (`backend/docmind/knowledge/catalog.py`, exported to `mobile/js/catalog.js`), and CI verifies that they classify documents and understand requests identically (`scripts/parity_check.py`).

**Phone edition security:** a passcode derives the key with PBKDF2 (600k iterations), so without it nothing can be decrypted. Every document has its own AES-256-GCM key. Protected folders wrap those keys with an RSA-3072 vault key whose private half is sealed by the vault PIN, so documents can be *added* to the vault without the PIN, but only the PIN opens them. The app auto-locks, slows down repeated wrong passcodes, and makes encrypted backup files for moving to a new phone. OCR (tesseract.js) is downloaded once from a CDN and then cached. Document bytes never leave the device.

**Android app: whole-phone scan.** The first scan indexes the whole phone (all folders, any age, memory card) and can take a while; search works during it. It keeps running with the screen off (an ongoing notification shows progress), and the index is kept permanently, so later scans only read new files. Two things to know:
1. **Don't swipe DocMind away from recent apps while it scans**, because that stops the scan. Turning the screen off or switching apps is fine. If it is stopped, it resumes where it left off next time.
2. **Battery saving** (Samsung and others) can pause background work. Tap **"Allow background activity"** on the scan screen (Android's own dialog), or set Settings → Apps → DocMind → Battery → **Unrestricted**.

> Tell it what you need. It finds what you have, remembers what you need, and helps you obtain what is missing.

DocMind is a working Stage 1 product. It is a mobile-first web app (installable PWA) with full Hebrew RTL and English, on a modular Python backend. The backend provides encrypted storage, on-device OCR, automatic classification, semantic search, a bilingual assistant, consent-based personal memory, and document bundles.

chunks.text:
## What works today (Stage 1, plus part of Stages 2 and 3)

| Area | Status |
|---|---|
| Accounts: scrypt passwords, 15-min JWT access tokens, rotating refresh cookie with reuse detection, sign out everywhere, rate limits | ✅ working, tested |
| Encrypted storage: AES-256-GCM per-file keys and per-user data keys (envelope encryption); OCR text and chat history encrypted too; crypto-shredding on delete | ✅ |
| Upload of PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF and TXT, with magic-byte sniffing (client MIME type ignored) | ✅ |
| On-device OCR, Hebrew and English (Tesseract), rotation retry, and OCR for scanned PDFs | ✅ |
| Classification into 30 document types and 12 categories (plus custom ones), with 13 common Israeli processes, including Israeli ID check digit, IBAN and passport MRZ signals | ✅ |
| Issuer, document date and expiry extraction; "may be outdated" flags | ✅ |
| Smart names for meaningless filenames (`IMG_20261115_132411.jpg` becomes "תעודת זהות") | ✅ |
| Personal classifier: a document you relabel teaches it about similar documents | ✅ |
| **Vault:** PIN-protected folders (identity, finance and medical by default, configurable), hidden in every response until unlocked; auto-lock after 5 minutes or when the app is left | ✅ |
| **Two-step verification** (Authenticator app, recovery codes), per-account lockout | ✅ |
| Exact and near duplicate detection; nothing is ever deleted automatically | ✅ |
| Natural-language and content search (character n-gram TF-IDF, robust to Hebrew prefixes and OCR noise), with filters for category, type, source, issuer, dates and tags | ✅ |
| Hebrew/English assistant: task detection, "which documents were required?", search of every source, statuses, official sources for missing documents | ✅ |
| Personal memory: checklists saved only after you approve; reused next time with "has anything changed?"; any change goes through a proposal; can be inspected, edited and deleted | ✅ |
| Bundles: preview, select, rename, download each file **individually** with organised names; optional combined PDF | ✅ |
| WhatsApp: import of an exported chat (.zip with media), the officially supported route | ✅ |
| iPhone HEIC and AVIF photos (decoded locally via libheif) | ✅ |
| Expiry reminders on the dashboard, plus a standard calendar file (.ics) for Google Calendar, iPhone or Outlook; reminder window is configurable | ✅ |
| Background index of Gmail/Drive attachments (encrypted metadata only, nothing downloaded) for fast discovery | ⚙️ tested with a mocked Google API |

chunks.text:
| Gmail and Google Drive: OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, read-only search, "found but not downloaded" status, link to the exact email, import into the library | ⚙️ implemented and tested against a mocked Google API; needs your OAuth credentials (see `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`) |
| Shared aggregate learning: k-anonymous, opt-in, process keys only | 🔒 built and **disabled by default** |
| External LLM (Anthropic or OpenAI) behind a provider abstraction; sends request wording only, never documents | ⚙️ optional, off unless configured **and** the user consents |
| Android gallery/downloads scanning | ⏳ Stage 3 (needs the native app); the UI says so honestly |

The assistant never claims to have searched a source it could not search. Each answer lists the sources searched and the ones that are not connected.

```bash

./start.sh        # Windows: double-click start.bat
# then open http://localhost:8000
```

**Install on your phone:** DocMind is an installable PWA (Chrome reports it installable). Reach your own computer privately over HTTPS with Tailscale's free Personal plan (`tailscale serve --bg 8000`), then use "Install app" / "Add to Home Screen". Step-by-step instructions are in `docs/SETUP_HE.md`.

Or with Docker (free):

```bash
cp .env.example .env    # fill in the keys
docker compose up --build
```

Development keys are generated automatically in `./data/`. For anything real, set the variables in `.env.example`.

Sample documents (clearly fictional, stamped SAMPLE) are in `backend/tests/fixtures/`. To regenerate them:

```bash
python scripts/make_sample_docs.py backend/tests/fixtures
```

"""HTTP API (JSON). See docs/API.md."""
from __future__ import annotations

import time

import jwt
from flask import Blueprint, current_app, jsonify, request

from ..connectors.google import ConnectorError
from ..security.auth import AuthError
from ..security.vault import VaultError
from ..services.bundles import BundleError
from ..services.documents import IngestError
from ..services.memory import MemoryError_

api = Blueprint("api", __name__, url_prefix="/api")


def ctx():
    return current_app.extensions["docmind"]


def body() -> dict:
    data = request.get_json(silent=True)
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def rate_limit(bucket: str, limit: int, window: int):
    if not ctx().limiter.allow(f"{bucket}:{request.remote_addr}", limit, window):
        return jsonify(error="rate_limited"), 429
    return None


# Short-lived signed links let the browser download/preview natively (good on mobile, enables
# downloading several separate files) without putting the long-lived token in a URL.
_used_links: dict[str, float] = {}


def sign_link(user_id: str, kind: str, ref: dict, ttl: int = 120) -> str:
    now = int(time.time())
    token = jwt.encode({"sub": user_id, "typ": "dl", "k": kind, "r": ref, "iat": now, "exp": now + ttl,
                        "jti": f"{now}-{id(ref)}-{time.perf_counter_ns()}"}, ctx().config.jwt_secret, algorithm="HS256")
    return f"/api/dl/{token}"


def verify_link(token: str) -> dict:
    payload = jwt.decode(token, ctx().config.jwt_secret, algorithms=["HS256"])
    if payload.get("typ") != "dl":
        raise jwt.InvalidTokenError("wrong type")
    now = time.time()
    for k, exp in list(_used_links.items()):
        if exp < now:
            _used_links.pop(k, None)
    if payload["jti"] in _used_links:
        raise jwt.InvalidTokenError("used")
    _used_links[payload["jti"]] = payload["exp"]
    return payload

"""Application factory."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from flask import Flask, jsonify, send_from_directory

from .assistant.llm import make_provider
from .config import load_config
from .db import Database, new_id, now_iso
from .knowledge.catalog import CATEGORIES
from .security.audit import RateLimiter
from .security.crypto import BlobStore
from .services.search import SearchIndex

FRONTEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend"


class AppContext:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.db = Database(config.db_path)
        self.blobs = BlobStore(config.blob_dir, config.master_key)
        self.search = SearchIndex(self.db, config.master_key)
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2, thread_name_prefix="docproc")
        self.llm = make_provider(config)
        self.limiter = RateLimiter()


def _seed_categories(db):
    for key, en, he, icon in CATEGORIES:
        if not db.one("SELECT 1 FROM categories WHERE user_id IS NULL AND key = ?", (key,)):
            db.insert("categories", {"id": new_id(), "user_id": None, "key": key, "name_en": en, "name_he": he,
                                     "icon": icon, "is_custom": 0, "created_at": now_iso()})


def _recover_stuck(ctx):
    """Documents left 'processing' by a crash/restart are re-queued."""
    for d in ctx.db.all("SELECT id, user_id FROM documents WHERE status = 'processing'"):
        from .services.documents import _process_safe
        ctx.executor.submit(_process_safe, ctx, d["user_id"], d["id"])


def create_app(overrides: dict | None = None) -> Flask:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    config = load_config(overrides)
    app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=None)
    app.config["MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH"] = max(config.max_upload_bytes * 10, 250 * 1024 * 1024)
    ctx = AppContext(config)
    ctx.db.migrate()
    _seed_categories(ctx.db)
    app.extensions["docmind"] = ctx
    if not config.process_sync:
        _recover_stuck(ctx)

    from .api import register
    register(app)

"""Dialogue engine: understands the request, runs discovery, manages task state and memory proposals."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import date

from ..db import new_id, now_iso
from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES, PROCESSES, doc_type_label
from ..security import crypto
from ..services import memory as memsvc
from ..services import shared_learning
from . import discovery, intent as intent_mod
from .texts import join_list, t


class Conversation:
    def __init__(self, ctx, user, conv_id: str | None):
        self.ctx, self.user = ctx, user
        row = ctx.db.one("SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (conv_id, user["id"])) if conv_id else None
        if not row:
            row = {"id": new_id(), "user_id": user["id"], "title": None, "state_json": "{}",
                   "created_at": now_iso(), "updated_at": now_iso()}
            ctx.db.insert("conversations", row)
        self.row = row
        self.state = json.loads(row["state_json"])

    @property
    def id(self):
        return self.row["id"]

    def save(self, title: str | None = None):
        values = {"state_json": json.dumps(self.state, ensure_ascii=False), "updated_at": now_iso()}
        if title and not self.row["title"]:
            values["title"] = title[:80]
            self.row["title"] = values["title"]
        self.ctx.db.update("conversations", self.id, values)

    def add_message(self, dek, role, text, payload=None) -> str:
        mid = new_id()
        self.ctx.db.insert("messages", {
            "id": mid, "conversation_id": self.id, "role": role,
            "content_enc": crypto.encrypt_text(dek, text, f"msg:{mid}"),
            "payload_enc": crypto.encrypt_text(dek, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False), f"msgp:{mid}") if payload else None,
            "created_at": now_iso()})
        return mid


def load_messages(ctx, dek, conv_id) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for m in ctx.db.all("SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at, rowid", (conv_id,)):
        payload = json.loads(crypto.decrypt_text(dek, m["payload_enc"], f"msgp:{m['id']}")) if m["payload_enc"] else None
        out.append({"id": m["id"], "role": m["role"], "text": crypto.decrypt_text(dek, m["content_enc"], f"msg:{m['id']}"),
                    "payload": payload, "created_at": m["created_at"]})
    return out

"""Local bilingual (Hebrew/English) intent parser. Deterministic, runs on-server, no data leaves."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from ..knowledge.catalog import PROCESSES, REQUEST_ALIASES

HEB = r"֐-׿"
_PREFIX = "(?:[והבלמשכ]{1,2})?"  # Hebrew attached prepositions/conjunctions: ו, ה, ב, ל, מ, ש, כ


@dataclass
class Intent:
    lang: str
    doc_types: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    process_key: str | None = None
    custom_purpose: str | None = None
    is_task: bool = False
    wants_again: bool = False
    yes: bool = False
    no: bool = False
    nothing_more: bool = False
    adding: bool = False
    greeting: bool = False
    find_only: bool = False
    help: bool = False
    free_text: str = ""


def detect_lang(text: str, fallback: str = "he") -> str:
    heb = len(re.findall(f"[{HEB}]", text))
    lat = len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]", text))
    if heb == lat == 0:
        return fallback
    return "he" if heb >= lat else "en"


def _norm(text: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower().replace("״", "\"").replace("׳", "'").replace("–", "-")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)


def _alias_regex(alias: str) -> re.Pattern:
    a = re.escape(_norm(alias))
    if re.search(f"[{HEB}]", alias):
        return re.compile(f"(?<![{HEB}\\w]){_PREFIX}{a}(?![{HEB}])")
    return re.compile(f"(?<![\\w]){a}(?![\\w])")


def _variants(alias: str) -> list[str]:
    """Hebrew construct phrases take the definite article on the LAST word:
    "אישור ניהול חשבון" -> "אישור ניהול החשבון", "תעודת זהות" -> "תעודת הזהות"."""
    words = alias.split()
    if len(words) > 1 and re.search(f"[{HEB}]", words[-1]) and not words[-1].startswith("ה"):
        return [alias, " ".join(words[:-1] + ["ה" + words[-1]])]
    return [alias]

"""Hebrew construct phrases take the definite article on the LAST word:
    "אישור ניהול חשבון" -> "אישור ניהול החשבון", "תעודת זהות" -> "תעודת הזהות"."""
    words = alias.split()
    if len(words) > 1 and re.search(f"[{HEB}]", words[-1]) and not words[-1].startswith("ה"):
        return [alias, " ".join(words[:-1] + ["ה" + words[-1]])]
    return [alias]


_ALIAS_TABLE = sorted(((v, dt, _alias_regex(v)) for dt, aliases in REQUEST_ALIASES.items() for a in aliases for v in _variants(a)),
                      key=lambda x: -len(x[0]))
_PROC_TABLE = sorted(((v, pk, _alias_regex(v)) for pk, p in PROCESSES.items() for t in p["triggers"] for v in _variants(t)),
                     key=lambda x: -len(x[0]))

_TASK_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"\b(?:documents?|docs|paperwork|everything|what(?:'s| is) needed)\b.*?\bfor\b\s+(?:my |a |an |the |another |this )?(.+)", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\bprepare\b\s+(?:everything|all|documents?)?.*?\bfor\b\s+(?:my |a |an |the |another |this )?(.+)", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b(?:submit|apply for|applying for|application for)\b\s+(?:my |a |an |the |another )?(.+)", re.I),
    re.compile(f"מסמכים\\s+(?:עבור|בשביל|ל|ל־|ל-)\\s*([{HEB}\\w\\s\"'-]+)"),
    re.compile(f"(?:להגיש|להגשת|הגשת|הגשה של|הגשה ל)\\s*([{HEB}\\w\\s\"'-]+)"),
    re.compile(f"(?:תכין|תכיני|הכן|להכין)\\s+(?:לי\\s+)?(?:את\\s+)?(?:כל\\s+)?(?:מה ש|המסמכים\\s+)?(?:צריך\\s+)?(?:עבור|בשביל|ל)\\s*([{HEB}\\w\\s\"'-]+)"),
]
_AGAIN = re.compile(r"\b(another|again|new|next|once more)\b|נוספת|נוסף|שוב|עוד פעם|חדשה|הבאה", re.I)
_YES = re.compile(r"^\s*(yes|yep|yeah|sure|ok|okay|please do|do it|confirm|correct|כן|בטח|אישור|מאשר|מאשרת|נכון|סבבה|יאללה|תשמור|שמור)\b", re.I)
_NO = re.compile(r"^\s*(no|nope|not now|don't|do not|לא|לא תודה|אל תשמור|לא עכשיו)\b", re.I)
_NOTHING_MORE = re.compile(r"\b(that'?s all|nothing else|no more|that is all|nothing)\b|זה הכל|זהו|אין עוד|לא צריך עוד|שום דבר", re.I)
_ADDING = re.compile(r"\b(also|add|plus|another document|in addition)\b|גם|בנוסף|תוסיף|תוסיפי|להוסיף|ועוד", re.I)
_FIND = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:please\s+)?(find|search|where(?:'s| is)|show me|locate)\b|^\s*(תמצא|תמצאי|מצא|חפש|תחפש|תחפשי|איפה|תראה לי|תראי לי)", re.I)
_GREETING = re.compile(r"^\s*(hi|hello|hey|good (?:morning|evening)|שלום|היי|הי|בוקר טוב|ערב טוב)\W*$", re.I)
_HELP = re.compile(r"\b(help|what can you do|how does this work)\b|עזרה|מה אתה יודע|מה את יודעת|איך זה עובד", re.I)


def parse(text: str, fallback_lang: str = "he") -> Intent:
    lang = detect_lang(text, fallback_lang)
    norm = _norm(text)
    it = Intent(lang=lang, free_text=text.strip())
    masked = norm
    for _alias, pk, rx in _PROC_TABLE:
        m = rx.search(masked)
        if m:
            it.process_key = pk
            masked = masked[:m.start()] + " " * (m.end() - m.start()) + masked[m.end():]
            break
    found: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    for _alias, dt, rx in _ALIAS_TABLE:
        for m in rx.finditer(masked):
            found.append((m.start(), dt))
            masked = masked[:m.start()] + " " * (m.end() - m.start()) + masked[m.end():]
    seen = set()
    for _, dt in sorted(found):
        if dt not in seen:
            seen.add(dt)
            it.doc_types.append(dt)
    if not it.process_key:
        for rx in _TASK_PATTERNS:
            m = rx.search(text)
            if m:
                purpose = re.sub(r"[.?!,]+$", "", m.group(1).strip())
                purpose = re.split(r"\s+(?:and|ו)?(?:please|בבקשה)\b", purpose)[0].strip()
                if 2 <= len(purpose) <= 80 and not _is_only_doc_names(purpose):
                    it.custom_purpose = purpose

chunks.text:
if not it.process_key:
        for rx in _TASK_PATTERNS:
            m = rx.search(text)
            if m:
                purpose = re.sub(r"[.?!,]+$", "", m.group(1).strip())
                purpose = re.split(r"\s+(?:and|ו)?(?:please|בבקשה)\b", purpose)[0].strip()
                if 2 <= len(purpose) <= 80 and not _is_only_doc_names(purpose):
                    it.custom_purpose = purpose
                    break
    it.is_task = bool(it.process_key or it.custom_purpose)
    it.wants_again = bool(_AGAIN.search(text))
    it.yes = bool(_YES.search(text))
    it.no = bool(_NO.search(text)) and not it.yes
    it.nothing_more = bool(_NOTHING_MORE.search(text))
    it.adding = bool(_ADDING.search(text))
    it.greeting = bool(_GREETING.match(text))
    it.find_only = bool(_FIND.search(text)) and not it.adding
    it.help = bool(_HELP.search(text))
    return it


def _is_only_doc_names(s: str) -> bool:
    n = _norm(s)
    for _alias, _, rx in _ALIAS_TABLE:
        n = rx.sub(" ", n)
    return not re.sub(r"[\s,.&]|\band\b|\bmy\b|ו", "", n)

chunks.text:
"""LLM provider abstraction.

Privacy contract: the assistant only ever sends the user's *request text* plus the list of
document-type keys, and only when (a) a provider is configured by the operator and (b) the user
has switched on “AI assistance” in Settings. Document contents, filenames and emails are never
sent. The local engine works fully without any provider.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re

import requests

from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES, PROCESSES

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SYSTEM = (
    "You map a user's request about personal documents to JSON. Reply with JSON only: "
    '{"doc_types": [...], "process_key": string|null, "custom_purpose": string|null}. '
    "doc_types must be chosen only from: " + ", ".join(DOC_TYPES) + ". "
    "process_key only from: " + ", ".join(PROCESSES) + ". Never invent other keys."
)


class LLMProvider:
    name = "none"
    available = False

    def complete(self, system: str, user: str) -> str | None:
        return None

    def parse_intent(self, text: str) -> dict | None:
        raw = self.complete(SYSTEM, text[:1000])
        if not raw:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw, re.S)
        if not m:
            return None
        try:
            data = json.loads(m.group(0))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return None
        # Validate strictly against the catalog; anything else is dropped.
        return {
            "doc_types": [d for d in data.get("doc_types") or [] if d in DOC_TYPES],
            "process_key": data.get("process_key") if data.get("process_key") in PROCESSES else None,
            "custom_purpose": (data.get("custom_purpose") or None) and str(data["custom_purpose"])[:80],
        }


class AnthropicProvider(LLMProvider):
    name = "anthropic"
    available = True

    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str | None):
        self.api_key, self.model = api_key, model or "claude-haiku-5-5"

def _load_key(env_name: str, dev_file: Path, env: str) -> bytes:
    raw = os.environ.get(env_name)
    if raw:
        key = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(raw + "=" * (-len(raw) % 4))
        if len(key) != 32:
            raise ValueError(f"{env_name} must be 32 bytes, base64url-encoded")
        return key
    if env == "production":
        raise RuntimeError(f"{env_name} is required in production")
    # Development convenience: persist a generated key next to the data.
    if dev_file.exists():
        return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(dev_file.read_text().strip())
    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
    dev_file.write_text(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(key).decode())
    os.chmod(dev_file, 0o600)
    warnings.warn(f"{env_name} not set: generated a development key at {dev_file}. "
                  "Never use this in production.", stacklevel=2)
    return key


def load_config(overrides: dict | None = None) -> Config:

"""Gmail + Google Drive via official REST APIs and OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE).

Read-only scopes. Tokens are encrypted with the user's data key. Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI; without them the connectors report `not_configured`
and are never shown as searched.

Note: gmail.readonly and drive.readonly are Google "restricted" scopes; a public launch needs
Google's OAuth app verification (and a security assessment for Gmail). Testing mode works with up
to 100 listed test users.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import logging

import requests

from ..db import new_id, now_iso
from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES, REQUEST_ALIASES
from ..security import crypto
from ..security.audit import audit
from ..services import classifier
from .base import Availability, Hit, LibraryConnector

AUTH_URL = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"  # noqa: S105 (endpoint URL, not a secret)
REVOKE_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke"
GMAIL = "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me"
DRIVE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3"
SCOPES = {
    "gmail": "openid email https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly",
    "gdrive": "openid email https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly",
}
HTTP_TIMEOUT = 20
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ConnectorError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, status: int = 400):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code
        self.status = status


def configured(ctx) -> bool:
    c = ctx.config
    return bool(c.google_client_id and c.google_client_secret and c.google_redirect_uri)

self.status = status


def configured(ctx) -> bool:
    c = ctx.config
    return bool(c.google_client_id and c.google_client_secret and c.google_redirect_uri)


# ---- OAuth ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def start_oauth(ctx, user, kind: str) -> str:
    if kind not in SCOPES:
        raise ConnectorError("unknown_connector", 404)
    if not configured(ctx):
        raise ConnectorError("not_configured", 409)
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
    challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    ctx.db.execute("DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE created_at < ?",
                   ((datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat(),))
    ctx.db.insert("oauth_states", {"state": state, "user_id": user["id"], "kind": kind, "verifier": verifier,
                                   "created_at": now_iso()})
    return AUTH_URL + "?" + urlencode({
        "client_id": ctx.config.google_client_id, "redirect_uri": ctx.config.google_redirect_uri,
        "response_type": "code", "scope": SCOPES[kind], "state": state, "access_type": "offline",
        "prompt": "consent", "include_granted_scopes": "false",
        "code_challenge": challenge, "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    })


def finish_oauth(ctx, code: str, state: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    row = ctx.db.one("SELECT * FROM oauth_states WHERE state = ?", (state,))
    if not row:
        raise ConnectorError("invalid_state")
    ctx.db.execute("DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE state = ?", (state,))
    if row["created_at"] < (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=15)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat():
        raise ConnectorError("state_expired")
    r = requests.post(TOKEN_URL, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, data={
        "code": code, "client_id": ctx.config.google_client_id, "client_secret": ctx.config.google_client_secret,
        "redirect_uri": ctx.config.google_redirect_uri, "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "code_verifier": row["verifier"],
    })
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise ConnectorError("token_exchange_failed", 502)
    tok = r.json()
    tok["obtained_at"] = int(time.time())
    user = ctx.db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (row["user_id"],))
    from ..security.auth import user_dek
    dek = user_dek(ctx, user)
    label = _email_from_id_token(tok.get("id_token"))
    ctx.db.execute("DELETE FROM connected_sources WHERE user_id = ? AND kind = ?", (user["id"], row["kind"]))
    ctx.db.insert("connected_sources", {
        "id": new_id(), "user_id": user["id"], "kind": row["kind"], "account_label": label,
        "tokens_enc": crypto.encrypt_text(dek, json.dumps(tok), f"oauth:{user['id']}:{row['kind']}"),
        "scopes": tok.get("scope", SCOPES[row["kind"]]), "status": "connected", "connected_at": now_iso(),
    })
    audit(ctx, user["id"], "connector.connect", row["kind"], account=label)
    return user["id"], row["kind"]

"""Authentication: short-lived JWT access tokens + rotating refresh tokens (httpOnly cookie)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from functools import wraps

import jwt
from flask import current_app, g, jsonify, request

from ..db import new_id, now_iso
from . import crypto

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")
REFRESH_COOKIE = "dm_refresh"


class AuthError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status: int = 401):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = message
        self.status = status


def validate_password(pw: str) -> None:
    if len(pw) < 10:
        raise AuthError("password_too_short", 400)
    if pw.lower() == pw or not re.search(r"\d", pw):
        raise AuthError("password_too_weak", 400)


def register_user(ctx, email: str, password: str, display_name: str, locale: str = "he") -> dict:
    email = (email or "").strip().lower()
    if not EMAIL_RE.match(email):
        raise AuthError("invalid_email", 400)
    validate_password(password or "")
    if ctx.db.one("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)):
        raise AuthError("email_taken", 409)
    uid = new_id()
    dek = crypto.new_key()
    ctx.db.insert("users", {
        "id": uid, "email": email, "password_hash": crypto.hash_password(password),
        "display_name": (display_name or email.split("@")[0])[:80],
        "locale": locale if locale in ("he", "en") else "he",
        "wrapped_dek": crypto.wrap_key(ctx.config.master_key, dek, f"user:{uid}"),
        "settings_json": "{}", "created_at": now_iso(),
    })
    return ctx.db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (uid,))


MAX_LOGIN_FAILS = 10
LOGIN_LOCKOUT = timedelta(minutes=15)

        if p.exists():
            # Best-effort overwrite; the real guarantee is that the wrapped key is deleted too.
            size = p.stat().st_size
            with open(p, "r+b") as fh:
                fh.write(secrets.token_bytes(size))
                fh.flush()
                os.fsync(fh.fileno())
            p.unlink()

"""Vault: a separate PIN that protects chosen categories (identity, finance, medical by default).

While the vault is locked, documents in protected categories are hidden in every API response
(names, dates, issuers, previews, text, thumbnails, downloads, search hits). Unlocking returns a
short-lived vault token (5 minutes) that the client keeps in memory only.
Brute force: 5 wrong PINs lock the vault for 15 minutes. Setting or changing the PIN requires the
account password.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import jwt

from ..db import now_iso
from . import crypto
from .audit import audit

DEFAULT_LOCKED = ["identity", "finance", "medical"]
VAULT_TTL = 5 * 60
MAX_FAILS = 5
LOCKOUT = timedelta(minutes=15)
PIN_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{4,12}$")
HEADER = "X-Vault-Token"


class VaultError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, status: int = 400):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code
        self.status = status


def settings(user) -> dict:
    return json.loads(user.get("settings_json") or "{}")


def has_pin(user) -> bool:
    return bool(user.get("vault_pin_hash"))


def locked_categories(user) -> list[str]:
    if not has_pin(user):
        return []
    return list(settings(user).get("locked_categories", DEFAULT_LOCKED))

def combined_pdf(ctx, user, bid) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    """Optional: merge selected items into one PDF (images become pages). Only on explicit request."""
    from PIL import ImageOps
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
    b = get_row(ctx, user, bid)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    added = 0
    for it in ctx.db.all("SELECT * FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ? AND selected = 1 AND document_id IS NOT NULL "
                         "ORDER BY position", (bid,)):
        doc = docsvc.get_owned(ctx, user["id"], it["document_id"])
        if not doc or not doc["is_local"]:
            continue
        data = docsvc.read_bytes(ctx, doc)
        if doc["mime_type"] == "application/pdf":
            for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data)).pages:
                writer.add_page(page)
            added += 1
        elif doc["mime_type"].startswith("image/"):
            from .extract import open_image
            img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(open_image(data, doc["mime_type"])).convert("RGB")
            buf = io.BytesIO()
            img.save(buf, "PDF", resolution=150)
            for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(buf.getvalue())).pages:
                writer.add_page(page)
            added += 1
    if not added:
        raise BundleError("nothing_to_combine", 409)
    out = io.BytesIO()
    writer.write(out)
    audit(ctx, user["id"], "bundle.download_combined", bid, files=added)
    return out.getvalue(), sanitize_filename(b["name"]) + ".pdf"

"""Document understanding: type classification, issuer, dates, expiry, outdated detection.

Two layers:
1. Knowledge-based scorer (weighted bilingual keywords on content + filename hints + structural
   signals such as a valid Israeli ID check digit, IBAN, passport MRZ).
2. Personal layer: documents the user has manually (re)labelled act as nearest-neighbour examples,
   so the classifier adapts to each user's own documents over time.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime

from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES, KNOWN_ISSUERS


@dataclass
class Classification:
    doc_type: str
    confidence: float
    category: str
    issuer: str | None = None
    doc_date: str | None = None
    expiry_date: str | None = None
    signals: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.lower()
    s = s.replace("״", "\"").replace("׳", "'").replace("”", "\"").replace("“", "\"")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)


def valid_israeli_id(num: str) -> bool:
    if not num.isdigit() or len(num) > 9 or set(num) == {"0"}:
        return False
    num = num.zfill(9)
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(num):
        d = int(ch) * (1 + i % 2)
        total += d - 9 if d > 9 else d
    return total % 10 == 0


def _structural_signals(text: str) -> dict[str, float]:
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    if re.search(r"P<ISR|P<[A-Z]{3}[A-Z<]{5,}", text):
        out["passport"] = 8
    if re.search(r"\bIL\d{2}\s?(?:\d{4}\s?){4}\d{3}\b", text):
        out["bank_confirmation"] = 1.5
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\d)(\d{9})(?!\d)", text):
        if valid_israeli_id(m.group(1)):
            out["id_card"] = out.get("id_card", 0) + 1.0
            out["id_appendix"] = out.get("id_appendix", 0) + 0.5
            break
    return out

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import zipfile

from . import classifier, extract

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PUBLIC_FIELDS = ("id", "source_kind", "source_url", "is_local", "original_filename", "display_name", "mime_type",
                 "size_bytes", "category_key", "doc_type", "doc_type_confidence", "doc_type_source", "issuer",
                 "doc_date", "expiry_date", "status", "error", "duplicate_of", "duplicate_kind", "archived",
                 "ocr_used", "language", "text_chars", "created_at", "updated_at")


class IngestError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, status: int = 400):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code
        self.status = status


def public(doc: dict, with_freshness: bool = True) -> dict:
    out = {k: doc.get(k) for k in PUBLIC_FIELDS}
    out["tags"] = json.loads(doc.get("tags_json") or "[]")
    out["is_local"] = bool(out["is_local"])
    out["archived"] = bool(out["archived"])
    out["ocr_used"] = bool(out["ocr_used"])
    if with_freshness:
        out["freshness"] = classifier.freshness(doc)
    return out


def _safe_name(name: str) -> str:
    name = PurePosixPath((name or "document").replace("\\", "/")).name
    name = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x1f<>:\"|?*]", "_", name).strip(" .") or "document"
    return name[:180]

"""Text extraction: native PDF text, OCR for images and scanned PDFs (on-device Tesseract, heb+eng).

Nothing in this module talks to the network: OCR runs locally so document contents never leave
the server for extraction.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import logging
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SUPPORTED_MIME = {
    "application/pdf": ".pdf",
    "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
    "image/png": ".png",
    "image/webp": ".webp",
    "image/heic": ".heic",
    "image/avif": ".avif",
    "image/tiff": ".tiff",
    "text/plain": ".txt",
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": ".docx",
    "application/msword": ".doc",
}
DOCX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"


@dataclass
class Extraction:
    text: str
    ocr_used: bool
    pages: int
    language: str | None


def sniff_mime(data: bytes, filename: str) -> str | None:
    """Detect type from magic bytes; never trust the client-supplied content type."""
    if data[:5] == b"%PDF-":
        return "application/pdf"
    if data[:3] == b"\xff\xd8\xff":
        return "image/jpeg"
    if data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n":
        return "image/png"
    if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return "image/webp"
    if data[4:8] == b"ftyp":
        brand = data[8:12]
        if brand in (b"avif", b"avis"):
            return "image/avif"
        if brand in (b"heic", b"heix", b"heim", b"heis", b"hevc", b"hevx", b"mif1", b"msf1"):
            return "image/heic"
    if data[:4] in (b"II*\x00", b"MM\x00*"):
        return "image/tiff"
    if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" and filename.lower().endswith(".docx"):
        return DOCX

"""Expiry reminders. Free and private: shown in-app and exportable as a standard iCalendar (.ics) file
that any calendar (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook) imports. No email/SMS service needed."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES
from . import documents as docsvc

DEFAULT_LEAD_DAYS = 60
ALLOWED_LEAD_DAYS = (14, 30, 60, 90)


def lead_days(user) -> int:
    v = json.loads(user.get("settings_json") or "{}").get("reminder_days", DEFAULT_LEAD_DAYS)
    return v if v in ALLOWED_LEAD_DAYS else DEFAULT_LEAD_DAYS


def upcoming(ctx, user, today: date | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    today = today or date.today()
    horizon = today + timedelta(days=lead_days(user))
    rows = ctx.db.all("SELECT * FROM documents WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 0 AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL "
                      "AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND expiry_date <= ? ORDER BY expiry_date", (user["id"], horizon.isoformat()))
    out = []
    for d in rows:
        exp = date.fromisoformat(d["expiry_date"])
        days = (exp - today).days
        out.append({"document": docsvc.public(d), "expiry_date": d["expiry_date"], "days_left": days,
                    "state": "expired" if days < 0 else "expiring"})
    return out


def _esc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace(";", "\\;").replace(",", "\\,").replace("\n", "\\n")


def _fold(line: str) -> str:
    # RFC 5545: lines longer than 75 octets are folded.
    b = line.encode("utf-8")
    if len(b) <= 75:
        return line
    parts, cur = [], b""
    for ch in line:
        e = ch.encode("utf-8")
        if len(cur) + len(e) > (75 if not parts else 74):
            parts.append(cur.decode("utf-8"))
            cur = b""
        cur += e
    parts.append(cur.decode("utf-8"))
    return "\r\n ".join(parts)

def calendar_ics(ctx, user, doc_ids: list[str] | None = None, exclude_categories: set[str] | None = None) -> bytes:
    lang = user.get("locale") or "he"
    lead = lead_days(user)
    sql = "SELECT * FROM documents WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 0 AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND duplicate_of IS NULL"
    rows = ctx.db.all(sql, (user["id"],))
    if doc_ids:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r["id"] in set(doc_ids)]
    if exclude_categories:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r["category_key"] not in exclude_categories]
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    lines = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:-//DocMind//Document reminders//HE", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
             "METHOD:PUBLISH", "X-WR-CALNAME:DocMind"]
    for d in rows:
        exp = date.fromisoformat(d["expiry_date"])
        label = DOC_TYPES.get(d["doc_type"], {}).get(lang) or d["display_name"]
        if lang == "he":
            summary = f"לחדש: {label} (פג תוקף {exp.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')})"
            desc = f"המסמך “{d['display_name']}” פג תוקף ב-{exp.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')}. תזכורת מ-DocMind."
        else:
            summary = f"Renew: {label} (expires {exp.strftime('%d %b %Y')})"
            desc = f"“{d['display_name']}” expires on {exp.isoformat()}. Reminder from DocMind."
        start = max(exp - timedelta(days=lead), date.today())
        lines += ["BEGIN:VEVENT", f"UID:docmind-{d['id']}@docmind.local", f"DTSTAMP:{stamp}",
                  f"DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:{start.strftime('%Y%m%d')}",
                  f"DTEND;VALUE=DATE:{(start + timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y%m%d')}",
                  f"SUMMARY:{_esc(summary)}", f"DESCRIPTION:{_esc(desc)}", "TRANSP:TRANSPARENT",
                  "BEGIN:VALARM", "ACTION:DISPLAY", f"DESCRIPTION:{_esc(summary)}", "TRIGGER:PT9H", "END:VALARM",
                  "END:VEVENT"]
    lines.append("END:VCALENDAR")
    return ("\r\n".join(_fold(ln) for ln in lines) + "\r\n").encode("utf-8")

"""Semantic-ish search over a user's documents.

Character n-gram TF-IDF (robust to Hebrew prefixes like ה/ו/ב/ל and to OCR noise) over filename,
display name, bilingual type/category labels, issuer, tags and decrypted text. The index is built
in memory per user on demand and invalidated on every document change; plaintext is never written
to disk. The `Embedder` seam lets a neural embedding model replace TF-IDF without API changes.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import threading

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

from ..knowledge.catalog import CATEGORIES, DOC_TYPES, REQUEST_ALIASES
from ..security import crypto

_CAT = {k: (en, he) for k, en, he, _ in CATEGORIES}


def doc_search_text(doc: dict, text: str) -> str:
    t = DOC_TYPES.get(doc["doc_type"], {})
    cat = _CAT.get(doc["category_key"], ("", ""))
    aliases = " ".join(REQUEST_ALIASES.get(doc["doc_type"], []))
    tags = " ".join(json.loads(doc.get("tags_json") or "[]"))
    head = " ".join(filter(None, [doc["display_name"], doc["original_filename"], t.get("en"), t.get("he"),
                                  aliases, cat[0], cat[1], doc.get("issuer"), tags]))
    # Metadata is repeated so it weighs more than incidental words deep in the body text.
    return f"{head} {head} {text[:6000]}"


def _normalise(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.lower().replace("״", "\"").replace("׳", "'")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)


class SearchIndex:
    def __init__(self, db, master_key: bytes):
        self.db = db
        self.master_key = master_key
        self._cache: dict[str, tuple] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def invalidate(self, user_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._cache.pop(user_id, None)

    def _build(self, user_id: str, dek: bytes):
        docs = self.db.all("SELECT * FROM documents WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 0 AND status = 'ready'",
                           (user_id,))
        if not docs:
            return [], None, None
        corpus = [_normalise(doc_search_text(d, crypto.decrypt_text(dek, d["text_enc"], f"doctext:{d['id']}")))
                  for d in docs]
        vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=1)
        matrix = vec.fit_transform(corpus)
        return docs, vec, matrix

if not docs:
            return [], None, None
        corpus = [_normalise(doc_search_text(d, crypto.decrypt_text(dek, d["text_enc"], f"doctext:{d['id']}")))
                  for d in docs]
        vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=1)
        matrix = vec.fit_transform(corpus)
        return docs, vec, matrix

    def _get(self, user_id: str, dek: bytes):
        with self._lock:
            hit = self._cache.get(user_id)
        if hit:
            return hit
        built = self._build(user_id, dek)
        with self._lock:
            self._cache[user_id] = built
        return built

    def search(self, user_id: str, dek: bytes, query: str, limit: int = 20, min_score: float = 0.08,
               exclude_categories: set[str] | None = None) -> list[tuple[dict, float]]:
        docs, vec, matrix = self._get(user_id, dek)
        if not docs or not query.strip():
            return []
        if exclude_categories is None:
            from ..security.vault import current_hidden
            exclude_categories = current_hidden()
        sims = cosine_similarity(vec.transform([_normalise(query)]), matrix)[0]
        ranked = sorted(zip(docs, sims, strict=True), key=lambda x: -x[1])
        # Content of protected documents must not influence results while the vault is locked.
        ranked = [(d, s) for d, s in ranked if d["category_key"] not in exclude_categories]
        return [(d, float(s)) for d, s in ranked[:limit] if s >= min_score]

    def nearest_labelled(self, user_id: str, dek: bytes, text: str, filename: str) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
        """Personal classifier layer: nearest document the user labelled themselves (text-to-text)."""
        labelled = self.db.all("SELECT id, doc_type, text_enc FROM documents WHERE user_id = ? AND doc_type_source = 'user' "
                               "AND status = 'ready' AND archived = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 500", (user_id,))
        texts = [_normalise(crypto.decrypt_text(dek, d["text_enc"], f"doctext:{d['id']}")) for d in labelled]
        pairs = [(d, t) for d, t in zip(labelled, texts, strict=True) if len(t) >= 10]
        if not pairs or len(text.strip()) < 10:
            return None
        vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), sublinear_tf=True)
        m = vec.fit_transform([t for _, t in pairs] + [_normalise(text)])
        sims = cosine_similarity(m[-1], m[:-1])[0]
        j = int(sims.argmax())
        return pairs[j][0]["doc_type"], float(sims[j])

"""Anonymised aggregate learning — architecture in place, DISABLED by default.

What may be contributed: only (canonical process key, canonical document type) pairs from a
checklist the user explicitly approved. Never: free-text names, document contents, email data,
filenames, dates, or user ids. Contributors are recorded as a keyed HMAC so a user counts once per
pair; patterns are only surfaced once K distinct contributors agree (k-anonymity).

Both the global flag (DOCMIND_SHARED_LEARNING) and the per-user opt-in must be on.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from ..knowledge.catalog import DOC_TYPES, PROCESSES
from ..security.crypto import hmac_hex

K_ANONYMITY = 20


def _opted_in(ctx, user) -> bool:
    if not ctx.config.shared_learning_enabled:
        return False
    return bool(json.loads(user.get("settings_json") or "{}").get("shared_learning_opt_in"))


def contribute(ctx, user, process_key: str, doc_types: list[str | None]) -> int:
    if process_key not in PROCESSES or not _opted_in(ctx, user):
        return 0
    contributor = hmac_hex(ctx.config.jwt_secret, f"shared:{user['id']}")
    added = 0
    for dt in {d for d in doc_types if d in DOC_TYPES}:
        cur = ctx.db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shared_contributions VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (contributor, process_key, dt))
        if cur.rowcount:
            ctx.db.execute("INSERT INTO shared_patterns VALUES (?, ?, 1) ON CONFLICT(process_key, doc_type) "
                           "DO UPDATE SET contributors = contributors + 1", (process_key, dt))
            added += 1
    return added


def suggestions(ctx, process_key: str) -> list[str]:
    if not ctx.config.shared_learning_enabled or process_key not in PROCESSES:
        return []
    return [r["doc_type"] for r in ctx.db.all(
        "SELECT doc_type FROM shared_patterns WHERE process_key = ? AND contributors >= ? ORDER BY contributors DESC",
        (process_key, K_ANONYMITY))]

"""The headline product flow: first request -> ask requirements -> find -> remember (with consent)
-> second request reuses the checklist -> asks what changed -> never silently edits memory."""
from docmind.assistant.intent import parse


def results(reply, i=0):
    return {r["requirement"]["doc_type"]: r for r in [b for b in reply["blocks"] if b["type"] == "requirements"][i]["results"]}


def test_intent_parser_hebrew_and_english():
    it = parse("אני צריך מסמכים למלגת מילואים")
    assert it.process_key == "reserve_scholarship" and it.lang == "he" and it.is_task
    it = parse("Identity card and appendix, reserve order, proof of enrollment, and bank account confirmation.")
    assert it.doc_types == ["id_card", "id_appendix", "reserve_order", "enrollment_proof", "bank_confirmation"]
    it = parse("תעודת זהות וספח, צו מילואים, אישור לימודים ואישור ניהול חשבון")
    assert it.doc_types == ["id_card", "id_appendix", "reserve_order", "enrollment_proof", "bank_confirmation"]
    it = parse("I need the documents for my apartment insurance claim")
    assert it.custom_purpose == "apartment insurance claim" and it.is_task
    assert parse("Find my latest bank confirmation").doc_types == ["bank_confirmation"]
    assert parse("תמצא לי את אישור ניהול החשבון").doc_types == ["bank_confirmation"]
    assert parse("איפה תעודת הזהות והספח").doc_types == ["id_card", "id_appendix"]
    assert parse("צריך את אישור הלימודים ואת תלוש השכר").doc_types == ["enrollment_proof", "payslip"]


def test_full_learning_flow_english(library):
    s = library
    r1 = s.say("I need documents for a military reserve scholarship.", new=True)
    assert "Which documents were required" in r1["text"]
    sugg = [b for b in r1["blocks"] if b["type"] == "suggestions"][0]
    assert "suggestions only" in sugg["note"]

    r2 = s.say("Identity card and appendix, reserve order, proof of enrollment, and bank account confirmation.")
    res = results(r2)
    assert set(res) == {"id_card", "id_appendix", "reserve_order", "enrollment_proof", "bank_confirmation"}
    assert all(r["status"] == "found_local" for r in res.values())
    assert res["enrollment_proof"]["best"]["document"]["original_filename"] == "download (3).pdf"
    searched = [b for b in r2["blocks"] if b["type"] == "requirements"][0]["sources_searched"]
    assert [x["key"] for x in searched] == ["device_files"]  # only what is really searchable
    assert "additional documents" in r2["text"]
    prop = [b for b in r2["blocks"] if b["type"] == "proposal"][0]["proposal"]
    assert prop["kind"] == "create_checklist"
    assert s.get("/api/memory").json["checklists"] == []  # nothing saved without consent

    r3 = s.say("yes")
    assert "Saved" in r3["text"]
    cl = s.get("/api/memory").json["checklists"]
    assert len(cl) == 1 and len(cl[0]["items"]) == 5

    # Second application: checklist reused automatically.
    r4 = s.say("I need to submit another military reserve scholarship application.", new=True)
    assert "saved checklist" in r4["text"] and "anything changed" in r4["text"]
    assert set(results(r4)) == set(results(r2))
    assert not [b for b in r4["blocks"] if b["type"] == "proposal"]
    # Suggestions beyond the checklist are labelled as suggestions.
    sugg = [b for b in r4["blocks"] if b["type"] == "suggestions"][0]
    assert sugg["items"][0]["doc_type"] == "reserve_service_confirmation"

import pytest
from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag

from docmind.security import crypto

def test_encrypt_roundtrip_and_tamper():
    k = crypto.new_key()
    blob = crypto.encrypt(k, b"secret", aad=b"ctx")

    with pytest.raises(InvalidTag):
        crypto.decrypt(k, blob, aad=b"other-context")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidTag):
        crypto.decrypt(crypto.new_key(), blob, aad=b"ctx")

    assert s.post("/api/me/2fa/setup", json={"password": "nope"}).status_code == 403
    setup = s.post("/api/me/2fa/setup", json={"password": PW}).json
    assert setup["otpauth_uri"].startswith("otpauth://totp/DocMind:")
    assert s.post("/api/me/2fa/enable", json={"code": "000000"}).status_code == 400
    codes = s.post("/api/me/2fa/enable", json={"code": totp.now_code(setup["secret"])}).json["recovery_codes"]

    r = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "mfa@example.com", "password": PW})
    assert client.post("/api/auth/mfa", json={"mfa_token": r.json["mfa_token"], "code": codes[0]}).status_code == 200
    r = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "mfa@example.com", "password": PW})
    assert client.post("/api/auth/mfa", json={"mfa_token": r.json["mfa_token"], "code": codes[0]}).status_code == 401
    # secret is encrypted at rest
    row = ctx.db.one("SELECT totp_secret_enc FROM users WHERE email = 'mfa@example.com'")
    assert setup["secret"].encode() not in row["totp_secret_enc"]


def test_account_lockout_after_repeated_failures(client, ctx):
    Session(client, email="lock@example.com")
    ctx.limiter.allow = lambda *a, **k: True  # isolate the per-account lockout from per-IP rate limiting
    codes = [client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "lock@example.com", "password": "bad"}).status_code
             for _ in range(10)]
    assert codes == [401] * 10
    r = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "lock@example.com", "password": PW})
    assert r.status_code == 429 and r.json["error"] == "account_temporarily_locked"
